meta.name: competitive-teardown
meta.description: 定位图 + 功能矩阵 + 价格对比 + 机会窗口, 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做产品竞品分析或制定产品策略
copy.tagline_en: Turn competitor data into product decision reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing competitors or defining product strategy

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把竞品资料整理成一份产品战略报告:定位图、竞品卡片、功能矩阵、价格对比、机会窗口,以及 30/90/180 天行动建议。它只用你给的资料,查不到的地方会标成 unknown 并列出资料缺口。
howto.when: 当你提供 2-6 个竞品的官网、定价页、评论等资料,或要求做竞品拆解时触发。只给一个竞品时,输出单竞品 deep dive。

say.text: 按 war-room-grid 风格把这三家竞品做成拆解报告
say.note: 产出定位图、功能矩阵与行动建议等板块

say.text: 用我给的竞品定价和评论,给我 30/90/180 天行动建议
say.note: 会先出判断与机会窗口,再列分阶段动作

say.text: 我只有一个竞品的资料,做一份单竞品 deep dive
say.note: 输出单竞品的卡片式拆解

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns competitor material into a product strategy report: positioning map, competitor cards, feature matrix, pricing read, opportunity windows, and 30/90/180-day moves. It only uses what you supply; gaps are marked unknown and listed under evidence gaps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide material on 2-6 competitors (sites, pricing pages, reviews, etc.) or ask for a competitive teardown. With only one competitor, it outputs a single-competitor deep dive.

say_en.text: Turn these three competitors into a teardown report in war-room-grid style
say_en.note: Outputs positioning map, feature matrix, moves, etc.

say_en.text: Using my pricing and review notes, give me 30/90/180-day moves
say_en.note: Leads with judgments and opportunity windows

say_en.text: I only have one competitor; do a single-competitor deep dive
